sanity.dropout: disabled via eval mode for train-only memorization mechanics; not retrieval accuracy

supervision: event_relative: query/event-balanced positive BCE plus per-query background BCE weighted .1; GT-duration-relative SmoothL1; event-balanced original GIoU; original saliency losses unchanged
initialization: same immutable parent model weights and torch RNG for both; reset AdamW in both arms and restart same LR schedule; not exact continuation of old optimizer
primary: event_relative minus mask_only dense internal-validation mAP at fixed final update; isolates objective bundle under same mask-safe fine-tuning; compare both with immutable parent and E4
stop_rule: train-only sanity and two fixed 800-step arms; all validation metrics only after both endpoints saved; no best epoch, objective/seed/threshold search, no fresh queries/labels/inference
scope: diagnostic repair on same 254 train sources and repeatedly observed 64-source/65-query internal validation; not independent generalization or full paper replication
